answer: Here is one mechanism that works: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because velvet only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, forge is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any lagoon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
